reason: The orthorhombic cell is strongly established (20/20 low-angle lines indexed, M(20)=320.2), and both CIFs parse and symmetry-expand to fully occupied Li10Fe2Te4S4 cells with 20 atoms. Atomic recovery is not sufficiently established, however. The selected P21212 model's reported full-profile Rwp is about 0.103 and its apparent improvement over the submitted Pmmn-limit model is obtained with periodic Li-Fe and Li-Li contacts of 1.926 and 1.989 A; the trace's diffraction-only polish lowers Rwp only to about 0.095 while increasing the short-contact penalty from about 0.00056 to 8.15. The chemically cleaner Pmmn realization removes those compressed cation contacts but has a materially poorer instantiated profile fit (trace Rwp about 0.122). Thus the data-supported symmetry/Li-ordering choice remains coupled to a demonstrable chemical failure, while the viable submitted alternative lacks comparable atomic-intensity support; another attempt is likely to add a materially different chemically valid ordering or framework realization.
